authorization.expected_discount: This repo's measured selection-leak ladder is PF 1.99 -> 1.45 -> 0.82. Expect realised below backtest.
authorization.note: No broker order, chart attachment, preset or demo authority. CFD confirmation now complete on 14 months of real Capital.com bid/ask; Dukascopy USA500.IDX-USD 2016+ still downloading for a long-history CFD-proxy check.

cfd_confirmation.basis: Capital.com demo M5 bid/ask, 2025-06..2026-07, session-close anchored
cfd_confirmation.caveat: 14 months and 382 trades (t=2.21) versus 10 years of index history. This test establishes that the real spread does not destroy the edge - it does not estimate effect size better than the 10-year index test, and the window was a favourable regime.
cfd_confirmation.execution: entry pays the ask; 0.5% stop tested on the bid low (gap-through fills at the bid open); exit receives the bid; no cost model on top

cost_model.basis: uniform, ~2.5x the measured US500 spread of 0.008% (6 points at p95, point 0.1)

forex_bar_gates.passed: 4/6 on index levels, 5/6 on CFD quotes

pf_excluding_best_5pct_ge_1.20.note: closer on CFD but still short; U8 shows capping the tail destroys the system

instrument_selection.basis: measured range/cost screen on live Capital.com demo, 21 days of ticks

BTCUSD.note: $500 spread; worst on the account, below EURUSD

partitions.note: stop level and universe both selected on design only; validation used once for reporting

rejected_variants.U2_conviction_ladder: leverage not edge; drawdown doubled, exTop5 worsened
rejected_variants.U4_intraday_reversal: 0 of 24 cells; M15/M30 strongly negative (continuation, not reversal)
rejected_variants.U6_trend_filter: worse on every axis including drawdown
rejected_variants.U8_profit_target: PF 0.725 design; capping upside against a 0.5% stop destroys the payoff asymmetry

rule.entry: at the daily close of the signal day
rule.entry_signal: previous daily close below the close before it
rule.exit: next daily close if the stop was not hit
rule.stop_fill_rule: if the next day opens at or below the stop, fill at the open; otherwise fill at the stop level
rule.weighting: fixed 1/3 of risk capital per index, always
